name: StudyPilot
problem: Students drown in pages of notes before exams
Re-reading is slow; without review, material fades in days
AI chatbots need internet and paid keys, and can hallucinate
Tier-2/3 colleges often have weak Wi-Fi and costly mobile data

stats.label: students in Indian higher education (AISHE 2021-22, approx.)
for unreviewed material to fade (Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, approx.)
StudyPilot cost per query: no API key, no data plan

solution: Paste or upload notes and get a full revision kit in ~6 ms
Summary, concepts, quiz, flashcards and Q&A from your own notes
Everything extractive and explained, so nothing is made up
Pure Python on any laptop, 100% offline and private

features.title: TextRank summary
features.desc: Adjustable length, per-sentence scores and a similarity graph

features.title: Key concepts
features.desc: RAKE keyphrases as weighted chips with highlighted evidence

features.title: Auto quiz
features.desc: Cloze and MCQ with similar-type distractors and typo-tolerant grading

features.title: SM-2 flashcards
features.desc: Auto-made cards, Again/Hard/Good/Easy, schedule saved locally

features.title: Ask your notes
features.desc: BM25 answers with highlights, confidence and term breakdown

features.title: Exam readiness
features.desc: Mastery per concept from quiz and card history, plus study-next

architecture: Browser UI (vanilla JS + SVG) -> tabs, readiness sidebar
app.py ThreadingHTTPServer -> JSON API, validation, cache
text.py -> tokenizer, sentence splitter, stop words, stemmer
textrank / keyphrases / bm25 -> summary, concepts, retrieval
quiz / flashcards / srs -> cloze, MCQ, SM-2 scheduling
algorithms: Okapi BM25 + definition bonus – question answering
tech: Python 3 stdlib only (http.server, re, math, json)
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, inline SVG, no CDN
JSON file persistence with atomic writes
innovation: Hallucination-free: every output is a sentence from your notes
Explains every decision: scores, links, distractors, SM-2 changes
Closed loop: summary to recall to spaced review to readiness
Runs on a ₹15k laptop with Wi-Fi off

results.label: QA top-3 hit rate on 31 questions (top-1 80.6%)
full analysis of a 780-word note set

demo_flow: Turn Wi-Fi off and click Load demo notes
Summary: drag length slider, click Why? and graph nodes
Concepts: click a chip to see its evidence
Quiz: answer with a typo, check answers, see readiness rise
Flashcards: flip, rate Good and Again, see the SM-2 schedule
Ask: question with highlights and confidence, then an off-topic one
impact: AI study help for students with poor connectivity
No subscription, no API cost, no mobile data
Notes and progress never leave the device
CPU-only inference in milliseconds, negligible energy
business: Free core app for every student
College licence: LAN server and class readiness dashboards
White-label quiz generation for ed-tech and coaching
Premium packs: Tamil/Hindi support, PDF import
future: Tamil and Hindi tokenisers and stemmers
